description: English-first treatment for developer-facing docs that currently have Russian-primary content or mixed-language triggers. The main target is docs/engineering/sdk-registry.md (intro block entirely in Russian) and docs/runbooks/README.md (Russian trigger phrases in the Quick Access table). Also add English translation/context for Russian UI strings in docs/HITL.md, docs/CLIENT_PIPELINE.md, and docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_CACHE.md. Keep Russian content where appropriate (e.g., portfolio resume-case-study.md bilingual summary is intentional, domain-specific examples in src/ READMEs are test data). The goal is that developer process docs are readable English-first while preserving Russian where it serves the domain or localized UI.
steps: Rewrite docs/engineering/sdk-registry.md intro block (the blockquote after the title) to English-first. Keep the same information but write it in English. Optionally add a one-line note that the original was in Russian if helpful for context. Leave the per-SDK sections (aiogram, aiogram-dialog, etc.) as-is since those contain Russian field names that match code patterns.

In docs/runbooks/README.md Quick Access table, add English equivalents for the Russian trigger phrases. Format: 'English description (Russian: original phrase)' - e.g., 'Recent Langfuse traces (Russian: izuchi poslednie treysy)' or simply replace with English-only descriptions since the runbook links already have English titles.
In docs/HITL.md, add English translations inline for the Russian button labels and status messages (lines with Cyrillic in the inline keyboard example and the cancel response).
In docs/CLIENT_PIPELINE.md, add English translation for the Russian contextual follow-up examples in the store guard description.
In docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_CACHE.md, add English translation for the Russian query pattern examples.
In mini_app/frontend/README.md, add English for the Russian string in the VITE_BOT_USERNAME description.
Run the relative-link verification script to confirm no links were broken.
acceptance_criteria: docs/engineering/sdk-registry.md intro blockquote is in English
docs/runbooks/README.md Quick Access table trigger phrases are in English (Russian may appear as parenthetical reference)
Russian UI strings in docs/HITL.md, docs/CLIENT_PIPELINE.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_CACHE.md have inline English translations
Domain-specific examples (src/ READMEs, portfolio/resume-case-study.md) are left unchanged
verification: Run the Python relative-link checker script from docs/engineering/docs-maintenance.md section 7
Visually confirm that docs/engineering/sdk-registry.md intro reads naturally in English
findings: All changes verified. git diff --check passed. Relative link checker passed for all modified files. Pre-existing broken links exist in docs/API_REFERENCE.md, docs/LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md, docs/indexes/fast-search.md, docs/indexes/local-runtime.md, and docs/superpowers/ but are unrelated to this feature.
